name: UMLAUF Sculpture Garden & Museum
tagline: The sculptor Charles Umlauf's wooded hillside studio, turned into a garden of 60+ bronzes.
description: A hillside sculpture garden below Zilker Park, built from the studio and lifetime output of Charles Umlauf, a UT professor who taught Farrah Fawcett among others. More than 60 of his bronzes and stone pieces are set along shaded paths in a restored oak-juniper woodland, with an indoor gallery for rotating shows.

tips.text: Pair with Zilker Park and Barton Springs — the garden is a 5-minute walk from the pool entrance.
Free admission the first Sunday afternoon of the month.
